claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Oxaprozin is a weak COX inhibitor with no potent cytotoxic off-target at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be a nonspecific NSAID/PPARgamma-associated apoptosis seen only at higher concentrations, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
